name: KGL2DMNPredicates
title: Knowledge graph L2DMN: predicates
description: The predicates of the L2DMN layer. An edge's `predicate` is one of these; which (source, target) pairs each licenses is the layer's edge table. Source: smart-base/L1/schemas/L2-DMN.ts (migrated from smart-kg ontology/L2-DMN/L2-DMN.json).

concept.definition: A decision is invoked by a business-rule task. Read from dmn:usingTask/@href, whose fragment is the URL-encoded task NAME rather than its id -- so it resolves only while that prose stays byte-identical in the BPMN, punctuation and the en dash in "Calmette-Guerin" included. Carries a resolutionStatus; the target is a bpmn-task when the BPMN is present and an opaque l1:external-artifact when it is not.

An input clause reads a data element. Recovered heuristically from free text, so every instance carries the extraction rule that produced it and a resolutionStatus. The target is an l2:data-element -- the DAK component -- so a recovered name and a declared dictionary entry are the same class and can meet when a dictionary exists.

A decision rule cites an L1 source. The target is an l1:citation minted from the same string by the citation extractor, so the DMN subgraph and the L1 graph join without either knowing the other exists. Grounded but sparse: 1 of 25 BCG rules. The sparseness is the finding -- a rule with no citesSource edge is a rule with no stated source.
